title: Error bounds on analytic Koopman-based Lyapunov functions
summary: The Koopman operator provides an infinite-dimensional linear description of nonlinear dynamical systems that can be leveraged in the context of stability analysis. In particular, Lyapunov functions can be obtained in a systematic way via the eigenfunctions of the Koopman operator. However, these eigenfunctions are computed from finite-dimensional approximations, resulting in approximated Lyapunov functions that must be validated.
